'''Maxin Davers''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Republic trooper]] member of the [[Forty-fifth Battalion]] serving the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]]. Davers fought during the [[Battle of Rhen Var]] and was severally wounded in battle. He was healed of his wounds by the [[Jedi healer/Legends|Jedi healer]] [[Syo Bakarn]].<ref name="LS1" />
